title: Character frequency
hints: `for _, r := range s` gives each rune `r` (decoded from UTF-8). Count into a `map[rune]int{}` with `freq[r]++`.
In `CharFrequency`, skip whitespace with `if unicode.IsSpace(r) { continue }`. `FirstUnique` builds its own counts that include whitespace.
Second pass in `FirstUnique`: `for _, r := range s { if counts[r] == 1 { return r, true } }`, then `return 0, false` after the loop. Walking `s` (not the map) is what makes it "first".
